# FQHESphereLValue

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereLValue`

Manual: [FQHESphereLValue (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FQHESphereLValue.md)

```text
FQHESphereLValue, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereLValue [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --state : name of the file that contains the state whose average L value has to be evaluated
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -z, --total-lz : twice the total lz value of the system (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    --project-spin : project onto single spin species of fermions with spin
    --sz-projection : can be set to either +1 or -1 (default value = 1)
    --sz : twice the total spin projection (default value = 0)
    -s, --statistics : particle statistics (bosons or fermions, try to guess it from file name if not defined)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --symmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --reference-state : reference state to start the Haldane algorithm from (can be laughlin, pfaffian or readrezayi3)
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the Haldane basis)
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
